Primary project instructions are in `.github/instructions/copilot-instructions.md`.

Keep this repository focused on Holiday Pre-Order Manager work.

Default structure:
- Backend API lives in `api/`
- Angular frontend lives in `web/`

Prefer updating existing files instead of creating many new docs.

Behavior priorities:
- Ask clarifying questions when requirements are ambiguous instead of guessing.
- Keep investigation narrow and cost-aware (targeted reads/searches first).
- Validate quickly after small edits.
